verdict.rationale: Fellow documents capturing in-person meetings, but only via desktop audio capture (fellow-docs-20, fellow-docs-76). It also documents searchable full transcripts and summaries for every conversation (fellow-docs-21, fellow-docs-23), plus audio/video uploads into the workspace (fellow-docs-78, fellow-docs-37). Recording, transcription and a shared searchable workspace are covered, but nothing shows a mobile app. Missing for 10: any evidence of a mobile recording app, mobile in-person capture flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
